record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PRECIPICE_BLADES: Groudon (3 stars, passive PRIMAL) and Primal Groudon (4 stars, passive DROUGHT_OR_SANDSTORM). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index). Both have maxPP 100 and range 1. The passives PRIMAL and DROUGHT_OR_SANDSTORM are not covered by this record.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage to every enemy-team unit standing in the same row or the same column as the caster (a cross through the caster's cell, whole board). Raw damage is [25, 50, 100, 120, 200] by caster stars: 100 for Groudon (3 stars), 120 for Primal Groudon (4 stars); 200 fallback. Each matching enemy is hit once (the row and column conditions are OR-ed). The cast target does not matter: it is passed to the base process but never used for targeting.

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity whose positionY equals the caster's positionY or whose positionX equals the caster's positionX, found by scanning every board cell
targeting.note: requiresTarget is true (the unit must be able to cast at a target) but the target only feeds the base broadcast; the hit set depends only on the caster's coordinates. Allies and empty cells are skipped; the caster's own cell holds an ally, so it is skipped. The scan reads the coordinates at the moment of the cast.

geometry.shape: cross: the caster's whole row and whole column, unlimited length (no range limit, no width), board-wide

effects.target: each enemy-team unit in the caster's row or column (each once)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per enemy hit, no falloff with distance. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x (1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect (consumed by the first hit); x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (see core-mechanics §A/§J). No heal, PP, shield or status is requested by this ability.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (3 and 4 for the listed units, bare factory values). The table has five entries; the 5th (200) equals the fallback and is reachable only at 5 stars, which neither listed unit has. The jump from 100 to 120 at 4 stars is as written in the source.

record.positionalConditions: Hits depend only on the caster's row and column: an enemy sharing neither is not hit; an enemy sharing both would be the caster's own cell (impossible for an enemy). The row/column test uses the caster's position at the moment of the cast and applies on the whole board, including off-front-line cells.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and rescans the board; the ability animation is broadcast once per hit cell.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 100 (Groudon, 3 stars) or 120 (Primal Groudon, 4 stars) per enemy in the cross. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage; a protect / skydiving / magicBounce target takes none.
